name: Machine CoNTROL Module

pins.quote: The outputs for these ports are isolated with dry contact relay closures Input and Output data ports are on 37 pin D ' fema connectors The M5200 interface connector and the input channel phanumeric displays (associated with the R58024 Routing Switcher) connector are 37 pin D ' male.

note: Each pin as a page of its own documents gives it (conf high: RTO-144 sheet or a connector-layout page; medium: rows of a rear-view drawing or a sentence of the manual; low: a schematic call-out; variant: none of its own, read from the variant named). Pins no page names are not listed.
